messages:
Chloe (AE): Quantum Retail POC: 10-day eval. Customer requires hosted keys first, but they insist on determinism for eval sets and may request Dedicated with pre-warmed KV cache. Also EU+UK residency. Who can own the runbook?
Ben (SE): I can lead. Need to confirm model family (open-opt vs gpt-like), whether they want temperature=0 gating for deterministic outputs, and if embeddings need to be reproducible.
Chloe (AE): They want open models, and will run deterministic suites at temp=0. Embeddings must match across runs for vector similarity tests.
Omar (Platform Eng): Hosted path: create trial org in eu-west-1, generate ephemeral key, set org caps. Determinism note: we'll fix random seeds and model config, but Dedicated gives stronger guarantees (fixed weights, single-tenant runtime, no dynamic quantization). Pre-warmed KV cache: we can seed prior to demo on Dedicated. Lead time for Dedicated in EU ~7 business days.
Priya (Security): Requirements noted: EU+UK data residency, SOC2 excerpt, KMS integration (customer likely wants BYO or tenant-scoped KMS). Also need to confirm dataset NDAs and export controls for embargoed product data. I'll prep the security attachment.
Ben (SE): Short runbook draft:
1) Create trial org quantum-poc (eu-west-1) + ephemeral API key
2) Share quickstart repo with a temp=0 example and repeatability checklist
3) Apply org billing cap $1,200 and alerts
4) If Dedicated requested: open infra ticket, schedule cache-seed window, and lock model version
5) Collect ops/security contact and NDA copy
Omar (Platform Eng): Internal CLI snippets:
```
rwctl org create --name "quantum-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org quantum-poc --note "poc-ephemeral"
rwctl dedicated create --org quantum-poc --gpus 8 --region eu-west-1 --private --note "prewarm-kv-allowed"
```
Priya (Security): I'll ask procurement for the NDA and KMS details. If they need tenant-scoped KMS, we require a short onboarding ticket.
deploy-bot: org quantum-poc created by Ben (SE)  hosted key pending rotation policy.
Ben (SE): I'll provision keys, push the temp=0 test script, and run a smoke determinism test. Will loop in Priya for NDA items.
Chloe (AE): Great. Owners: Ben = runbook + keys + tests, Priya = security + NDA, Omar = Dedicated sizing path. I'll set kickoff with Quantum Retail midday tomorrow. :rocket:
